thread:
jordan: Kicking off the billing_schema_v3 deploy now. Quiesce reached (step 3). Holding for read-replica checks and DB locks verification.

deploybot: Deploybot: rollout started for release/billing-schema-v3 · canary=2/2 · status=quiesced

maria: @jordan seeing replica-2 IO at 85% and replica lag ~6s. I'd prefer we wait 3-5m before applying the concurrent index.

jordan: ok, hold. pushing the holdpoint to +5m. will keep step 4 locked until we get green.

alex: if we end up aborting, can we pin services to migration-safe tag? suggest setting SERVICE_MIGRATION_PIN=true in k8s for billing-api.

linh: noted. I can flip the k8s annotation:
```
kubectl annotate deploy billing-api migration-pin=true --overwrite
kubectl rollout restart deploy/billing-api
```

opsbot: Opsbot: DB replica health check · replica-1 ok · replica-2 high-IO · replica-3 ok · replication_lag: 6s

maria: I'm going to run a quick read-only probe against replica-2 to see what's spiking. brb.

maria: probe done — heavy OLAP job from analytics-adhoc job_id=4389 landed on replica-2. queued a kill for that session.

opsbot: Opsbot: Killed session 0x9f4d from analytics-adhoc on replica-2. IO dropping.

jordan: replica-2 IO down to 32%, lag 1s. proceeding to step 4 in 90s. re-confirm rollback plan if step 4 fails.

alex: rollback checklist reminder:
- set migration_rollback=true feature flag
- revert schema GIT tag: git checkout refs/tags/schema-billing-v2
- trigger deploybot rollback: /deploy rollback release/billing-schema-v3

linh: posting release note snippet for ops channel after cutover.

deploybot: Deploybot: canary (2/2) -> applying migration step 4 (concurrent partial index)

jordan: running the index apply now. monitor p99 latency for billing-api and token service.

maria: p99 spike to 320ms on billing-api at index start. looks within expected warmup, not erroring.

linh: tagging ops: @oncall-db for watch during index apply.

opsbot: Opsbot: p99 latency watch hooked · alerts suppressed for expected window (10m).

jordan: index finished, backfills started for 1h window with rate limit 250 rows/s. starting slow-rollback guard: if p99 > 1s for 3 consecutive mins, auto-rollback.

maria: backfill progress 12% after 10m, no error traces.

alex: confirming feature flag will flip after backfill completes. PR link: https://git.internal/redwood/pulls/3421

jordan: excellent. keeping this thread for final cutover signal. if anyone sees anything critical, flag here or call oncall. :thumbsup:

linh: will publish short release note and set postmortem doc template if we hit the rollback hatch.

deploybot: Deploybot: release/billing-schema-v3 status=healthy · backfill=running · eta=50m

jordan: thanks all — leaving monitoring on. final update in ~30m or immediately if rollback triggers.
